packageRules.description: Gradle updates land on the dependency dashboard instead of opening PRs, and never auto-land — overriding the preset's automerge of minor/patch. Until cutover this repository is a COPY of modules that still build and publish from compose-ai-tools; its CI checks the device-dimensions catalog against a compose-ai-tools checkout, and its publishing is hard-blocked (see docs/VERSIONING.md). Moving the toolchain independently is divergence for no benefit while nothing here ships, and it has to be reconciled by hand at cutover. Delete this rule at cutover, when this repository owns these coordinates and can version them on its own.

robolectric: released versions only. Robolectric publishes a rolling `4.17-SNAPSHOT` to Sonatype and Renovate ranks it above `4.17-beta-2`, but this build declares no snapshot repository (nor should it, for a reproducible build) — so the bump resolves nowhere and fails every Android configuration. Kept deliberately even though the pruned catalog no longer carries Robolectric: this repository grows as modules move across, and the guard costs nothing until one of them needs it. The same applies to the other ceiling rules in compose-ai-tools' .github/renovate.json (compose-bom, material-kolor, coil3, compottie, org.jetbrains.compose, androidx.core, slf4j-nop) — port the matching one WITH the dependency whenever an entry comes back into libs.versions.toml. Eight PRs past those floors were opened and closed here before the catalog was pruned; every one of them had green CI, because nothing compiled against the dependency it bumped.
